name: Early Blight
localName: Sakit na nagdudulot ng maiitim na batik na may bilog-bilog na pattern sa dahon.

description.tl: Karaniwang nagdudulot ng kayumanggi o maiitim na batik sa dahon, minsan ay may magkakapatong na bilog at paninilaw sa paligid.
description.en: A fungal disease commonly associated with dark leaf lesions that may develop concentric rings and surrounding yellow tissue.

symptoms: Dark brown or black leaf lesions
management: Remove severely infected plant debris where practical
Improve airflow around plants
Avoid prolonged leaf wetness
Monitor new growth for spreading lesions

environmentalPrecautions: Dispose of infected material responsibly
Use only products registered for the affected crop and target disease
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the label and pre-harvest interval of any pesticide used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for dark lesions with concentric rings
Compare with Septoria Leaf Spot and other leaf spot diseases
Confirm the host crop before applying crop-specific advice

name: Healthy
localName: Walang malinaw na sintomas na nakita sa nasuring bahagi ng halaman.

description.tl: Walang malinaw na sintomas ng sakit o peste na nakita sa nasuring bahagi ng halaman. Hindi nito ginagarantiya na walang problema ang buong halaman.
description.en: No obvious pest or disease symptoms were detected in the inspected plant area. This does not guarantee that the entire plant is healthy.

management: Continue routine plant inspection
Check leaf undersides, stems, flowers, and fruits when applicable
Monitor for new or worsening symptoms

environmentalPrecautions: Do not apply pesticides without an identified reason.
safety.harvestRestrictions: No harvest restriction is implied by this result. Follow applicable pesticide labels if products have been used.

diagnosisGuidance: Interpret this result as no visible symptoms detected, not proof of disease absence
Consider image quality and model confidence

name: Late Blight
localName: Sakit na maaaring mabilis magdulot ng pagkasira at pag-itim ng dahon at bunga.

description.tl: Maaaring magdulot ng mga batik na parang nabasa sa dahon, tangkay, at bunga. Maaari itong mabilis kumalat sa malamig at basang kondisyon.
description.en: An oomycete disease that causes water-soaked lesions on susceptible plant tissues and may spread rapidly under favorable wet conditions.

symptoms: Possible pale growth on leaf undersides in humid conditions
transmission: Infected plant material and susceptible volunteer plants
management: Inspect nearby susceptible plants for rapid spread
Remove confirmed infected material according to local guidance
Improve airflow and reduce prolonged leaf wetness
Seek local agricultural advice if symptoms spread rapidly

environmentalPrecautions: Late blight is caused by an oomycete, not a true fungus
Verify that any treatment is labeled for the confirmed crop and target
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Check for irregular water-soaked lesions and rapid progression
Inspect both leaf surfaces under humid conditions
Differentiate from Early Blight and bacterial diseases

name: Leaf Miner
localName: Insekto na nag-iiwan ng paikot-ikot na lagusan sa loob ng dahon.

description.tl: Ang larvae ng ilang insekto ay kumakain sa loob ng tisyu ng dahon, na nag-iiwan ng mapuputi o paikot-ikot na lagusan.
description.en: Leaf-mining insect larvae feed within leaf tissue, leaving pale tunnels or blotchy mines.

symptoms: Leaf drying when damage is severe
transmission: Adult insects lay eggs on or within plant tissue; spread varies by species.
management: Inspect leaves for mines and larvae
Remove heavily infested leaves when practical
Monitor new growth for continuing damage
Identify the pest before choosing a control method

environmentalPrecautions: Avoid unnecessary broad-spectrum insecticide use
Verify the pest species and registered crop use before treatment
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for tunnels within the leaf rather than isolated surface spots
Do not infer a particular leaf-mining species from this general label

name: Leaf Mold
localName: Sakit na maaaring magdulot ng dilaw na batik at amag sa ilalim ng dahon.

description.tl: Sa karaniwang leaf mold ng kamatis, may mapusyaw na dilaw na bahagi sa ibabaw ng dahon at olibo o kulay-abong paglago sa ilalim, lalo na kapag mahalumigmig.
description.en: Tomato leaf mold commonly causes pale yellow areas on upper leaf surfaces and olive-gray fungal growth underneath under humid conditions.

symptoms: Pale yellow patches on upper leaf surfaces
management: Improve airflow around plants
Avoid unnecessary wetting of foliage
Remove severely affected leaves where practical
Monitor nearby plants for similar symptoms

environmentalPrecautions: Confirm the host and disease before using crop-specific treatment advice.
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Inspect both upper and lower leaf surfaces
The scientific name listed is associated with tomato leaf mold and should not automatically be applied to other hosts

name: Mosaic Virus
localName: Hindi pantay na mapusyaw at madilim na berdeng pattern sa dahon.

description.tl: Maaaring magdulot ng salit-salitang mapusyaw at madilim na berdeng bahagi sa dahon, pagbaluktot, at mahinang paglaki. Hindi sapat ang pattern lamang upang matukoy ang eksaktong virus.
description.en: Mosaic symptoms may include mottled green patterns, leaf distortion, and reduced growth, but the visual pattern alone does not identify a specific virus.

symptoms: Mottled light and dark green leaf patterns
transmission: Transmission depends on the virus; possible routes include insect vectors, infected plant material, seeds, or contaminated tools.
management: Inspect plants for symptoms and possible insect vectors
Sanitize tools between plants
Separate suspicious plants when practical while seeking confirmation
Consult agricultural personnel when viral infection is suspected

environmentalPrecautions: Do not present pesticides as a cure for an established viral infection
Choose vector management only after the likely virus and vector are assessed
safety.harvestRestrictions: No specific harvest interval is assigned here. Follow applicable product labels if treatments are used.

diagnosisGuidance: Describe this as mosaic symptoms unless the virus is identified
Check for alternative causes of leaf discoloration and distortion

name: Septoria Leaf Spot
localName: Maliliit na batik sa dahon na may maitim na gilid at mapusyaw na gitna.

description.tl: Karaniwang may maliliit na bilog na batik na may maitim na gilid at kulay-abuhin o mapusyaw na gitna. Ang eksaktong pathogen ay nakadepende sa host.
description.en: Septoria leaf spot commonly produces small lesions with dark margins and pale centers; the associated pathogen depends on the host.

symptoms: Yellowing and leaf drop in severe cases
management: Remove infected leaves where practical
Improve airflow
Avoid prolonged leaf wetness
Dispose of infected plant debris responsibly

environmentalPrecautions: Confirm the host and likely pathogen before selecting a chemical treatment.
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for numerous small spots with pale centers
Compare with Early Blight, which often develops larger lesions with concentric rings

name: Spider Mites
localName: Maliliit na peste na nagdudulot ng mapuputlang tuldok at minsan ay pinong sapot.

description.tl: Sumisipsip ng laman ng selula ng halaman ang spider mites, na maaaring magdulot ng mapuputlang tuldok, paninilaw, bronzing, at pinong sapot kapag marami na.
description.en: Spider mites feed on plant cells and may cause stippling, yellowing, bronzing, and fine webbing during heavier infestations.

transmission: Movement of infested plants or plant material
management: Inspect leaf undersides with a hand lens
Reduce plant water stress and excessive dust
Use directed water sprays only when suitable for the crop
Preserve predatory mites and other beneficial organisms

environmentalPrecautions: Some broad-spectrum insecticides can harm natural enemies and worsen mite outbreaks
Verify the crop and mite target on any pesticide label
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Inspect the underside of leaves for mites and eggs
Look for stippling and webbing together
Do not identify a mite species from this label alone

name: Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
localName: Paninilaw at pagkulot ng dahon na maaaring may kasamang bansot na paglaki.

description.tl: Maaaring makita ang paninilaw, pagkulot pataas, pagliit ng dahon, at bansot na paglaki. Kailangang kumpirmahin ang eksaktong virus batay sa host at diagnosis.
description.en: Symptoms may include yellowing, upward leaf curling, smaller leaves, and stunted growth. The exact virus requires confirmation.

transmission: Some leaf-curl viruses are transmitted by whiteflies; the specific route depends on the virus.
management: Inspect for possible insect vectors
Monitor nearby plants for similar symptoms
Seek confirmation before recommending virus-specific management
Use locally recommended vector management when appropriate

environmentalPrecautions: Do not claim that a pesticide cures an established viral infection
Avoid unnecessary insecticide use that may harm beneficial organisms
safety.harvestRestrictions: No specific harvest interval is assigned here. Follow applicable product labels if treatments are used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for a combination of yellowing, curling, and stunted growth
Distinguish symptoms from nutritional, environmental, and pest-related causes
Do not infer the exact virus from the class label alone

name: Anthracnose
localName: Sakit na maaaring magdulot ng lubog at maitim na batik sa bunga o ibang bahagi ng halaman.

description.tl: Ang anthracnose ay maaaring magdulot ng lubog na batik sa bunga, dahon, tangkay, o ibang bahagi. Nag-iiba ang sanhi at sintomas depende sa host.
description.en: Anthracnose is a group of fungal diseases that may cause sunken lesions on fruit and other plant tissues, depending on the host and pathogen.

symptoms: Possible dark lesions on leaves or stems
transmission: Contaminated tools or handling equipment in some cases
management: Remove severely affected plant material
Reduce prolonged wetness where practical
Avoid injuring fruit during handling
Confirm the host and likely pathogen

environmentalPrecautions: Do not use a crop-specific chemical recommendation until the host and target are verified.
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Check whether lesions are sunken and expanding
Consider the affected crop, plant part, and environmental conditions
Do not assign a species based on the generic class label

name: Black Spot
localName: Maiitim na batik sa halaman na maaaring may iba't ibang sanhi.

description.tl: Ang black spot ay pangkalahatang paglalarawan ng maiitim na batik. Hindi nito natutukoy kung fungal, bacterial, o ibang problema ang sanhi.
description.en: Black spot is a general description of dark lesions and does not identify a specific pathogen or cause.

symptoms: Possible enlargement or merging of spots
transmission: Depends on the actual cause; infectious cases may spread through water, air, or contaminated plant material.
management: Inspect the shape, location, and progression of lesions
Avoid unnecessary wetting of foliage
Remove severely affected material when appropriate
Seek confirmation before selecting a treatment

environmentalPrecautions: Do not recommend a pesticide solely from the generic Black Spot label.
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Treat the prediction as a dark-spot symptom category
Check host crop and lesion characteristics
Obtain expert confirmation if treatment depends on identifying the cause

name: Botrytis Gray Mold
localName: Pagkabulok na maaaring may kulay-abong malambot na amag sa apektadong bahagi.

description.tl: Maaaring magkaroon ng malambot na pagkabulok at kulay-abong amag sa nasugatan, namamatay, o nahihinog na tisyu ng halaman.
description.en: A fungal disease that can cause soft decay and gray mold on wounded, aging, or susceptible plant tissues.

symptoms: Brown lesions on flowers, stems, or fruit
Damage around wounds or aging tissue
management: Remove decaying plant material
Improve airflow
Avoid unnecessary wetting of flowers and foliage
Reduce plant injury and handle harvested produce carefully

environmentalPrecautions: Confirm the disease and crop before selecting a registered treatment.
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for gray fuzzy growth on decaying tissue
Consider whether the affected tissue is wounded or aging
Do not confuse every soft fruit rot with Botrytis

name: Cercospora Leaf Spot
localName: Batik sa dahon na nag-iiba ang hugis, kulay, at gilid depende sa halaman.

description.tl: Pangkat ng mga sakit na nagdudulot ng batik sa dahon. Nag-iiba ang itsura at sanhi ayon sa halamang tinamaan.
description.en: A group of fungal leaf spot diseases whose lesion appearance and causal species vary by host.

symptoms: Tan, gray, brown, or dark lesion centers depending on host
Possible yellowing and premature leaf drop
favorableConditions: Conditions favorable to the particular pathogen
transmission: Spores spread by air or water, depending on the pathogen
management: Inspect lesion patterns and the affected host
Remove infected debris where practical
Improve airflow and avoid prolonged leaf wetness
Confirm the host-pathogen combination before treatment

environmentalPrecautions: Do not assume that a treatment used for one Cercospora species is suitable for another.
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Use lesion characteristics as supporting evidence only
Confirm the crop and likely causal organism
Compare against other leaf spot diseases

name: Downy Mildew
localName: Sakit na maaaring magdulot ng dilaw na batik at mapusyaw na paglago sa ilalim ng dahon.

description.tl: Maaaring magdulot ng mapusyaw o dilaw na batik sa ibabaw ng dahon at downy na paglago sa ilalim sa angkop na kondisyon. Nag-iiba ang sanhi ayon sa host.
description.en: Downy mildew diseases may cause pale or yellow leaf lesions and downy growth underneath leaves; the causal organism depends on the host.

symptoms: Downy growth on leaf undersides in suitable conditions
Leaf browning or decline in severe cases
favorableConditions: Conditions favorable to the host-specific oomycete
transmission: Spores or other infectious structures spread through air or water, depending on the organism.
management: Improve airflow
Avoid prolonged leaf wetness
Remove severely infected plant material where appropriate
Confirm the host and disease before treatment

environmentalPrecautions: Downy mildew is generally associated with oomycetes, not true fungi
Verify that any treatment is labeled for the confirmed crop and disease
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Inspect both leaf surfaces
Consider the crop and environmental conditions
Do not use the class label to infer a specific species

name: Leaf Curl
localName: Pagkakulot ng dahon na maaaring dulot ng sakit, peste, o kondisyon ng kapaligiran.

description.tl: Ang pagkulot ng dahon ay sintomas at hindi awtomatikong patunay ng viral disease. Maaari itong maiugnay sa peste, kakulangan sa sustansiya, herbicide injury, o stress sa kapaligiran.
description.en: Leaf curl is a symptom rather than a confirmed disease and may result from viruses, pests, nutritional issues, herbicide injury, or environmental stress.

transmission: Depends on the underlying cause; viral causes may involve insect vectors, while noninfectious causes do not spread between plants.
management: Inspect leaf undersides and new growth for pests
Review watering, nutrition, and recent chemical exposure
Check nearby plants for similar symptoms
Seek confirmation before applying disease-specific treatment

environmentalPrecautions: Do not assume leaf curl is caused by a virus
Avoid pesticide application without identifying a likely target
safety.harvestRestrictions: No specific harvest interval is assigned here. Follow applicable product labels if treatments are used.

diagnosisGuidance: Treat this class as a visible symptom
Check for pests, environmental stress, and nutrient issues
Use a confirmed diagnosis before recommending treatment

name: Mycosphaerella Leaf Blotch
localName: Mga batik o malalawak na bahaging may pagbabago ng kulay sa dahon.

description.tl: Pangalan na maaaring tumukoy sa iba't ibang leaf blotch disease na nauugnay sa fungi. Kailangang malaman ang host at eksaktong pathogen upang maging tiyak ang diagnosis.
description.en: A label associated with leaf blotch diseases linked to fungi in the Mycosphaerella group; host and pathogen identification are needed for a specific diagnosis.

symptoms: Irregular areas of discolored leaf tissue
Possible yellowing or premature leaf drop
transmission: May involve spores and infected plant debris, depending on the causal organism.
management: Document the host crop and lesion appearance
Remove infected debris where appropriate
Monitor whether lesions spread
Obtain crop-specific confirmation before treatment

environmentalPrecautions: Do not infer a specific Mycosphaerella species from this model label.
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Confirm how this class was defined in the training dataset
Check the host crop and lesion characteristics
Keep the diagnosis provisional until the organism is verified

name: Powdery Mildew
localName: Maputi at parang pulbos na paglago sa ibabaw ng dahon o ibang bahagi.

description.tl: Karaniwang nakikita bilang puting pulbos na paglago sa dahon o ibang bahagi ng halaman. Nag-iiba ang species at host range depende sa halaman.
description.en: Powdery mildew commonly appears as white powder-like fungal growth on plant surfaces; the species and host range vary by crop.

symptoms: Reduced plant vigor in severe cases
favorableConditions: Conditions favorable to the host-specific powdery mildew
Dense growth and poor airflow may increase disease problems
management: Inspect the distribution and texture of the white growth
Improve airflow where practical
Remove severely affected material where appropriate
Confirm the host and disease before choosing a treatment

environmentalPrecautions: Verify crop registration and label instructions before pesticide use.
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for powder-like patches on plant surfaces
Differentiate from downy mildew and dried spray residue
Do not assign a species from the general class name

name: Rust
localName: Kahel, kalawangin, o kayumangging maliliit na bukol o pulbos sa halaman.

description.tl: Ang rust disease ay maaaring magdulot ng kulay-kahel, kayumanggi, o kalawanging pustules sa halaman. Nag-iiba ang pathogen at host range ayon sa crop.
description.en: Rust diseases may produce orange, brown, or rust-colored pustules on plant tissue; causal species and host range vary.

symptoms: Powdery spores released from some pustules
Yellowing or leaf decline in severe cases
favorableConditions: Conditions favorable to the particular rust species
Humidity may support infection in some rust diseases
transmission: Some rust species require alternate hosts
management: Inspect pustules and the affected plant parts
Remove heavily infected material where appropriate
Identify the host and likely rust organism
Seek crop-specific advice if the disease is spreading

environmentalPrecautions: Do not select a treatment without confirming the crop and target disease.
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for rust-colored pustules rather than flat dark spots alone
Confirm the host because rust fungi are often host-specific

name: Bacterial Spot
localName: Maiitim na batik sa dahon na maaaring may dilaw na paligid; minsan ay may batik din sa bunga.

description.tl: Maaaring magdulot ng maliliit na maiitim na batik sa dahon, minsan ay may dilaw na paligid, at mga batik sa bunga. Nag-iiba ang bacteria ayon sa host.
description.en: Bacterial spot may cause dark leaf spots, sometimes with yellow halos, and lesions on fruit; the causal bacteria vary by host.

symptoms: Possible raised or corky fruit lesions
Leaf yellowing or drop in severe cases
transmission: Infected seed or plant material in some cases
management: Avoid working with wet plants when possible
Use clean tools and suitable planting material
Remove severely infected material where appropriate
Avoid overhead irrigation where practical

environmentalPrecautions: Confirm bacterial disease before treatment
Use only products registered for the crop and target
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Check leaf spots and any fruit lesions
Compare with fungal leaf spot diseases
Visual symptoms alone may not confirm the bacterial cause

name: Fruit Rot
localName: Pagkabulok ng bunga na maaaring dulot ng sakit, pinsala, o ibang kondisyon.

description.tl: Ang pagkabulok ng bunga ay maaaring sanhi ng fungi, bacteria, o hindi nakahahawang problema. Hindi matutukoy ang eksaktong sanhi sa pangalang ito lamang.
description.en: Fruit rot can result from fungi, bacteria, or noninfectious problems. The label alone does not identify the cause.

symptoms: Soft, watery, or discolored fruit tissue
Possible foul odor depending on the cause
transmission: Depends on the cause; some infectious causes spread through contact, spores, or contaminated tools.
management: Remove rotting fruit from the plant or storage area
Reduce fruit injury during handling
Review watering and storage conditions
Identify the likely cause before treatment

environmentalPrecautions: Do not assume all fruit rot is caused by a treatable pathogen
Dispose of rotten produce responsibly
safety.harvestRestrictions: Do not consume produce that is rotten or unsafe. Follow any applicable pesticide label restrictions.

diagnosisGuidance: Check whether decay begins at wounds, blossom ends, stems, or other locations
Inspect for mold, insect entry holes, and storage-related damage
Treat this as a symptom category until the cause is identified

name: Melon Thrips
localName: Napakaliit na insekto na nag-iiwan ng mapuputi o pilak na gasgas sa dahon.

description.tl: Ang melon thrips ay maliliit at makikitid na insektong sumisira sa ibabaw ng dahon at iba pang bahagi habang kumakain. Kailangang kumpirmahin ang species dahil magkahawig ang pinsala ng iba't ibang thrips.
description.en: Melon thrips are tiny slender insects that feed on plant tissue and may cause pale or silvery feeding scars. Species confirmation may be needed.

symptoms: Small slender insects on affected tissue
transmission: Movement of adult insects between plants
management: Inspect young leaves and flowers for thrips
Monitor the level of damage over time
Preserve beneficial insects
Confirm the pest before choosing a control method

environmentalPrecautions: Avoid unnecessary broad-spectrum insecticide use
Verify the crop and target pest on the product label
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for slender insects and silvery feeding scars
Distinguish thrips damage from mite stippling
Confirm species if treatment recommendations depend on it

name: Fruit Borer
localName: Uod na bumubutas at kumakain sa loob ng bunga.

description.tl: Ang fruit borer ay pangkalahatang tawag sa mga larvae na bumubutas at kumakain sa bunga. Maaaring magkaiba ang species at paraan ng pagkontrol depende sa crop.
description.en: Fruit borer is a general label for larvae that bore into and feed inside fruit. Species and control methods vary by crop.

transmission: Adult insects lay eggs on or near susceptible plant parts; the life cycle depends on the species.
management: Inspect fruit for entry holes and frass
Remove and properly dispose of infested fruit
Monitor susceptible plant parts regularly
Identify the borer species before choosing a treatment

environmentalPrecautions: Do not assume all fruit borers are the same species
Verify crop-specific registration and label directions before pesticide use
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for entry holes, frass, and internal feeding
Check the affected crop and plant part
Do not substitute a specific pest identity without supporting evidence

name: Aphids
localName: Maliliit na insektong kumpol-kumpol sa murang tubo at ilalim ng dahon.

description.tl: Ang aphids ay maliliit na insektong sumisipsip ng katas ng halaman. Maaari silang magdulot ng pagkulot ng dahon, malagkit na honeydew, at mahinang paglaki.
description.en: Aphids are small sap-feeding insects that may cause distorted growth and produce sticky honeydew.

symptoms: Possible sooty mold growing on honeydew
transmission: Some aphid species transmit plant viruses
management: Inspect the undersides of leaves and growing tips
Monitor infestation levels
Preserve lady beetles, lacewings, and other natural enemies
Use physical removal or directed water where appropriate for the crop

environmentalPrecautions: Avoid unnecessary broad-spectrum insecticides that harm beneficial insects
Confirm the target and crop label before using any pesticide
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for clusters of insects and sticky honeydew
Check for distorted new growth
Aphid presence does not by itself confirm a viral infection

name: Flea Beetles
localName: Maliliit na salagubang na nag-iiwan ng maraming maliliit na bilog na butas sa dahon.

description.tl: Ang flea beetles ay maliliit na salagubang na kumakain sa dahon at karaniwang nag-iiwan ng maraming maliliit na butas na parang binutas ng karayom.
description.en: Flea beetles are small beetles that feed on foliage, often leaving numerous small round holes.

symptoms: Numerous small round holes in leaves
Severe damage to young seedlings in some crops
transmission: Adult beetles move between plants; life cycle and host range vary by species.
management: Inspect leaves for beetles and fresh feeding damage
Monitor seedlings closely
Use suitable physical barriers where practical
Confirm the pest before selecting a control method

environmentalPrecautions: Avoid unnecessary pesticide use, especially when damage is minor
Verify crop registration and label directions before treatment
safety.harvestRestrictions: Follow the product label and applicable pre-harvest interval if a pesticide is used.

diagnosisGuidance: Look for many small, relatively round feeding holes
Inspect for the beetles when damage is fresh
Do not confuse feeding holes with leaf spot lesions

name: Bacterial Wilt
localName: Pagkalanta ng halaman kahit may sapat na tubig; kailangang kumpirmahin ang bacterial cause.

description.tl: Maaaring magdulot ng mabilis na pagkalanta kahit may sapat na tubig sa lupa. Hindi sapat ang pagkalanta lamang upang kumpirmahin ang bacterial wilt.
description.en: Bacterial wilt can cause plants to wilt despite adequate soil moisture, but wilting alone is not sufficient to confirm the bacterial cause.

symptoms: Possible bacterial streaming in a suitable diagnostic test
favorableConditions: Conditions favorable to the causal bacterial strain and host
Warm soil may favor some bacterial wilt cases
transmission: Contaminated tools and movement of soil
management: Inspect soil moisture and root condition
Avoid moving potentially contaminated soil between areas
Clean tools after handling suspicious plants
Seek local diagnostic confirmation and crop-specific management advice

environmentalPrecautions: Do not move potentially contaminated soil or water to clean growing areas
Do not assume routine fungicide treatment will control bacterial wilt
safety.harvestRestrictions: No specific harvest interval is assigned here. Follow applicable product labels if treatments are used.

Inspect roots and stems when practical
Distinguish from water stress and other vascular diseases
Confirm the bacterial cause before making a definitive diagnosis
